Buy to let management for landlords with several properties

More properties mean more repairs, more certificates and more invoices. GETLET keeps them in one system so your picture stays clear as you grow.

Book a Rental Valuation

What portfolio landlords tell us matters

Cash flow, control and consistent contractors

One rent system

Rent for each property is collected and paid out through PayProp, so you are not reconciling several arrangements.

Costs you can trace

Every piece of work is entered as an invoice before it is deducted, which helps you compare costs across properties.

A vetted contractor network

Repairs are routed to contractors we have already checked, for consistency across your homes.

Control where you want it

Choose how involved you are

You can choose the plan that suits your involvement. Our two plans let you keep the final say on repairs or delegate within agreed limits.

Portfolio terms, volume arrangements and how reporting is organised across several properties are discussed individually. Pricing is by written quotation.

Request a written quotation

Property management for landlords who want a clear choice of involvement, transparent rent accounting and a repairs process they can follow.
